text:
Leon Draisaitl leads the Oilers with 23 goals in 26 games, and Daily Faceoff has him at the front of the Rocket Richard race with Cutter Gauthier. He adds 24 assists and 18 power-play points, and at 5v5 Edmonton takes 60.1% of the attempts with him on the ice.

Now the honest part. Those 23 goals come from 15.2 expected (the quality of his chances), so he is shooting 23.5% against 19% last season, and the Oilers have scored 23.3 more goals than expected with him out there. The chances themselves are real: 1.59 expected goals per 60 on his own shots, up from 1.02 a year ago. Our talent range sets his true shooting near 17.3%.

The last ten games were a heater: ten goals and 18 points against 16.2 expected, including two-goal nights against Vancouver and the Rangers, and goals in each of the last two losses.

He also sees the ice. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 14.5 primary shot assists per 60 last season, 99th percentile among forwards, and our wins-added measure ranks him fourth in the league.
